description: Offline and enhanced-for-leads click conversions posted to the Google Ads API UploadClickConversions method, including the JSON Conversion payload. Conversion adjustments are vendor/google-ads-conversion-adjustments. The image pixel on /pagead/conversion is a different pack.

params.name: conversions
params.description: UploadClickConversions requires a `conversions` array.
params.fix_hint: Send at least one ClickConversion in `conversions`.

params.name: partialFailure
params.description: Google documents `partial_failure` as required, and the upload guides say to always send true.
params.fix_hint: Set `partialFailure` to `true`.

params.name: conversionAction
params.description: It is the conversion action resource name, and every uploaded click conversion requires it.
params.fix_hint: Set `conversionAction` to `customers/{id}/conversionActions/{id}`.

params.name: conversionDateTime
params.description: Google documents the conversion time with a timezone offset as `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss+|-hh:mm`.
params.fix_hint: Send a timestamp such as `2026-08-21 12:00:00+00:00`.

params.name: gclid
params.description: Google click ID. A click-ID upload needs exactly one of `gclid`, `gbraid`, or `wbraid`.

params.name: gbraid
params.description: App-to-web click identifier from iOS. Alternative to `gclid`.

params.name: wbraid
params.description: Web-to-app click identifier. Alternative to `gclid`.

params.name: userIdentifiers
params.description: Hashed user identifiers for enhanced conversions for leads. The upload service accepts `hashedEmail` and `hashedPhoneNumber` only, at most five.

params.name: userIdentifiers[].hashedEmail
params.description: Email must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Lowercase and trim the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: userIdentifiers[].hashedPhoneNumber
params.description: Phone must be E.164 and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Normalize to E.164, hash with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: currencyCode
params.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code for `conversionValue`. Google documents both together.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`, together with `conversionValue`.

params.name: conversionValue
params.description: It is the conversion value for the advertiser. Google documents it together with `currencyCode`.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `1.0`, with no currency symbol, together with `currencyCode`.

params.name: userIpAddress
params.description: It is the customer IP on the landing page after the click, sent unhashed. Google documents the device address, not the advertiser server.

params.name: orderId
params.description: It is the order ID for the conversion. Google documents one order id per conversion action, and recommends it for later adjustments.
params.fix_hint: Send `orderId` as a string, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: conversionEnvironment
params.description: It is where the conversion was recorded. Google documents `APP` or `WEB`.
params.fix_hint: Set `conversionEnvironment` to `APP` or `WEB`.

params.name: customerType
params.description: It is whether the converting user is new or returning. Google documents `NEW` or `RETURNING`.
params.fix_hint: Set `customerType` to `NEW` or `RETURNING`.

params.name: consent.adUserData
params.description: It is consent for ad user data on the click conversion. Google documents `GRANTED` or `DENIED`.
params.fix_hint: Send `consent.adUserData` as `GRANTED` or `DENIED`.

params.name: cartData.merchantId
params.description: It is the Merchant Center ID where the cart items are uploaded.
params.fix_hint: Send `cartData.merchantId` as a whole number.

params.name: cartData.feedCountryCode
params.description: It is the country code of the Merchant Center feed the items come from.
params.fix_hint: Send `cartData.feedCountryCode`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: cartData.feedLanguageCode
params.description: It is the language code of the Merchant Center feed the items come from.
params.fix_hint: Send `cartData.feedLanguageCode`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: cartData.localTransactionCost
params.description: It is cart-level discounts such as free shipping or coupons. The currency is the same as `currencyCode`.
params.fix_hint: Send `cartData.localTransactionCost` as a number, such as `2.50`, without a currency symbol.

params.name: cartData.items[].productId
params.description: It is the Merchant Center product identifier for a purchased item.
params.fix_hint: Set `cartData.items[].productId` to the Merchant Center id, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: cartData.items[].quantity
params.description: It is how many of that item were sold.
params.fix_hint: Send a whole number in `cartData.items[].quantity`, such as `1`.

params.name: cartData.items[].unitPrice
params.description: It is the unit price excluding tax, shipping, and cart-level discounts.
params.fix_hint: Send `cartData.items[].unitPrice` as a number, such as `19.99`, without a currency symbol.

params.name: customVariables[].conversionCustomVariable
params.description: It is the custom conversion variable resource name.
params.fix_hint: Set `conversionCustomVariable` to `customers/{id}/conversionCustomVariables/{id}`.

params.name: customVariables[].value
params.description: It is the custom variable value. Google documents that it must not carry private customer data such as email or phone.
params.fix_hint: Send a non-empty custom variable value with no email or phone.

params.name: externalAttributionData.externalAttributionCredit
params.description: It is the fraction of the conversion attributed to the Google Ads click.
params.fix_hint: Send `externalAttributionCredit` as a number, such as `0.3`.

params.name: externalAttributionData.externalAttributionModel
params.description: It is the name of the external attribution model.
params.fix_hint: Send `externalAttributionModel`, or drop the empty pair.

rules.message: The conversion has no click ID and no `userIdentifiers`. Google documents a `gclid`, `gbraid`, or `wbraid` for click-ID uploads, or hashed user identifiers for enhanced conversions for leads.
The conversion sends `conversionValue` without `currencyCode`. Google documents the ISO 4217 code together with the value.
The conversion sends `currencyCode` without `conversionValue`. Google documents both together.
rules.fix_hint: Add `conversionValue` as a number, with no currency symbol.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. Google requires email as `hashedEmail`, SHA-256 hashed after normalization.
rules.fix_hint: Normalize the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send `userIdentifiers[].hashedEmail`.

rules.message: `userIpAddress` looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Google documents it as the customer IP, unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address of the customer's device.
